fields.description: Issue dated November 17, 1934 (Vol. 9, No. 9) of Miami Life. Prominent coverage includes allegations and legal interrogatories concerning the Miami Jockey Club and pari-mutuel operations (including calls for dissolution/accounting and questions about revenues, payments, and political influence), and local political conflict involving Mayor Sewell and the Miami city commission over governance and proposed liquor-related fees/taxes following repeal. The issue also contains columns and short items on local personalities and events, extensive advertisements, entertainment listings, and radio program schedules (e.g., WQAM/WIOD), along with sports and racing tips.
